notes.title: Patch 1.01 [Changelist]
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your support! Here is the list of updates for our first patch. Expect at least 1 more patch before we fully launch the game. We hope you enjoy!

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
Fixed physics for push/pull cheese
Removed ability to climb mid bone throw animation
Removed endless climb bug
Fixed #1 spawn issue in 01_McSkin_Bones
Fixed #2 spawn issue in 01_McSkin_Bones
Fixed 'climb down' problem in several levels
Bones automatically attaches to wall after ladder interaction
Fixed area near end of 01_bones_skin where bones was dying
Fixed spawn issue in 02_McSkin
Removed ability to control character during camera

[u]General[/u]
Removed settings functionality
Added credits screen
Changed keyboard mappings

[u]Level[/u]
Added victory screen to end of levels
Minor gameplay improvements for Triplets 01 and Triplets 04
Collision fixed for buttons
Collision fixed for air vents
Replaced cheese cube models
Added cheese VFX to end of levels

[u]UI[/u]
Added Pause Menu Buttons
Updated UI audio for controller
Added 'B' button functionality for UI
Updated push/pull tutorial bubble
Updated bonemerang tutorial bubble
Added 'B' to cancel tutorial bubble
Added Bonemerang interaction tutorial bubble
Changed location of bonemerang tutorial bubble
Updated character switch tutorial bubble
Added parachute interaction tutorial bubble
Added ladder interaction tutorial bubble
Added hover over asset for  level select back arrow
Added controller/keyboad mappings to pause screen
Added interaction information to pause screen
Updated level select map
Updated main menu

[u]Sound[/u]
Added elevator button sound
Added McSkin celebration VO
Added Meaty wall break VO
Reduced master volume significantly
Swapped Cheese push/pull sound
Adjusted audio levels
Added Bones Scared VO
Swapped/edited vent turn on
Swapped/edited vent turn off
Designed 1 track for menu/UI.
Designated 2nd track for levels
restricted xylophone sound to just bones animation
Edited platform appear sound
Updated bonemerang throw VO

[u]Visual[/u]
Interactive button mesh updated
Updated camera for interactable button
Breakable wall color changed
Appear/disappear platform model changed
McSkin glide rotation updated
Interactive button color changed
Added button art to Paused menu
Changed text of Paused menu items
